author: DPA
title: Recipe: Watermelon salad is weird? Try honeydew melon and cucumber - NewsBreak
text:
The classic watermelon salad with feta gets a new twist with this refreshing summer salad, where slightly sweeter and firmer honeydew melon meets crunchy cucumber and marinated feta. By slicing the honeydew melon and cucumber into thin strips, the flavour and texture become more refined. The dressing then provides a true explosion of flavour: fennel seeds and dill add a spicy aniseed aroma, mint and lemon zest bring a fresh note, and spring onions and chives give the dressing a delicate onion taste. Instead of mixing the dressing into the salad, I let the feta marinate in it briefly. Later, it is simply added as a topping along with the dressing. This keeps the flavours of the honeydew melon and cucumber more pronounced. Ingredients for 6 servings: ・1 organic lemon
・1 pinch of fennel seeds
・1 spring onion
・1 tsp dill (finely chopped)
・1 tsp mint (finely chopped)
・1 tsp chives (finely chopped)
・Salt
・Pepper
・1 tbsp white balsamic vinegar
・6 tbsp olive oil
・400 g feta
・1 honeydew melon
・2 cucumbers
Preparation: ・Wash the lemon with hot water and dry it. Grate about 1 tsp of the zest. Squeeze the juice. Crush the fennel seeds in a mortar. Trim the roots and dark green part of the spring onion, then finely chop the white part.
・In a bowl, mix about 2 tbsp of lemon juice, 1 tbsp of white balsamic vinegar, 6 tbsp of olive oil with the crushed fennel seeds, spring onion and herbs, and season with salt and pepper. Dice the feta and gently mix it into the dressing. Let it marinate for about 15 minutes.
・Halve and peel the honeydew melon. Remove the seeds and fibres from the inside. Then, use a vegetable peeler to cut the flesh into thin strips. Peel the cucumber and also cut the flesh into thin strips with a vegetable peeler (up to the seeds, which are not used).
・In a large bowl, gently mix the honeydew melon and cucumber. Divide the mixture into portions on plates, top with the feta and dressing, and serve.
